name: Linkding
description: A fast, self-hosted bookmark manager with tags, full-text search over your saved links, and a REST API. Local page archiving needs the 'plus' image variant (see postInstall).
postInstall: Linkding has no self-service signup. This stack pre-creates an 'admin' account; set its password with `docker exec -it linkding python manage.py changepassword admin`, then open it and sign in. Local HTML archiving requires switching to the linkding 'plus' image.
